rows.en: Kururu: "Thanks for saving me."
Clovis: "Are you all right? Are you hurt anywhere?"
Kururu: "I'm fine. How about you, old man?"
Clovis: "I'm fine. ...But
could you stop calling me 'old man'?
I'm not that old yet."
Arthur: "Oh? The very fact that you care about that
proves you qualify perfectly well."
Clovis: "Shut up. ...Don't call me 'old man.'
Use my name. Got it?"
Kururu: "Okay. I get it, Old Man Clovis!"
Aurelie: "Ha ha ha! You've gotta face reality,
Old Man Clovis."
Arthur: "Quite. Knowing when to give up is important too."
Clovis: "H-hmph!"
Thora: "...Thank you all very much."
Celica: "No, we should be thanking you. And the village was damaged..."
Thora: "Without your efforts,
it might have been far worse.
Please don't let it trouble you."
Celica: "But..."
Man: "Ho ho ho ho! My, it is hot."
Fain: "Who is this round old guy...?"
Thora: "Village Elder... You're back?"
Fain: "V-Village Elder?! I-I beg your pardon!"
Village Elder: "Ho ho ho. Think nothing of it.
It seems you have been through a great deal.
But the damage to the village is minor,
and no one was injured.
There is no need for you to blame yourselves.
On the contrary, we should be thanking you
for protecting Thora and Kururu
from Steinies."
Touya: "That Steinies bastard seemed to be looking
for Thora and Kururu..."
Village Elder: "Yes. He has a personal feud
with Grad... A very troublesome man."
Fain: "!! By G-Grad... Do you mean that Grad?!"
Village Elder: "I do not know which Grad you mean,
but I am speaking of Major Grad Burgley.
Thora's husband."
Celica: "That's it! I thought I'd heard
the name Burgley somewhere before..."
Fain: "What?! You are the wife
of Lord Grad Burgley, the 'Lion of the West'?!
Had I but known! Please forgive my many discourtesies!"
Thora: "Y-you don't have to be so formal..."
Fain: "No! That will not do.
Even if we come from different nations, Lord Grad Burgley
is an exemplar of knighthood.
Setting aside the holders of Sword Radiance,
he is one of the Three Strongest Knights of the Continent.
Meeting his wife is the highest honor!"
Thora: "I-I see..."
Kururu: "I'm Dad's daughter too, you know."
Fain: "Forgive me. Indeed, from the moment we first met,
I thought there was something special about the sparkle in your eyes!"
Touya: "Oh, come on..."
Fain: "Heh... My master often said
he would not want to fight Lord Grad. There are only a handful
on the continent who could make my master say such a thing.
Truly, I am overcome with emotion!
Though it is a pity I am not meeting the man himself... Hm?
Come to think of it, I heard Lord Grad left the army..."
Village Elder: "Yes. Until recently, Grad was living
in this village as well. But to bring him back into the army,
the Zigrim military hinted at danger to Thora and Kururu,
and threatened him.
Steinies was the negotiator at the time."
Touya: "Yeah, that bastard seems like the kind who'd do something
that dirty without a second thought."
Village Elder: "It was a great help that you were here.
We could not have protected them on our own.
Ho ho ho ho."
Touya: "But even if we drove him off this time,
won't that bastard come back?"
Village Elder: "There is no need to worry.
Once I report this incident to General Growster,
this village will not be attacked again.
Until now, we had no proof he would attack,
so there was nothing we could do.
Besides, Grad is a hero to us, the people of Zigrim.
Of course we would protect his wife and daughter."
Fain: "Oh! What a splendid spirit!
Village Elder! You are a model warrior!"
Yamato: "But he looks like an ordinary civilian..."
Village Elder: "Ho ho ho ho. From what I hear,
you rescued Prince Tix safely as well.
All's well that ends well, is it not?"
Ymir: "It is a relief to hear you say that."
Village Elder: "Please stay here and relax tonight.
We pride ourselves on our food as well as our hot springs,
so do stay."
Ymir: "Are you sure?"
Village Elder: "Having people from the Holy Land stay with us
would be good publicity too."
Ai: "You're pretty shrewd."
Village Elder: "Ho ho ho ho."
Touya: "Phew! I'm stuffed."
Yamato: "The food here is pretty close to Japanese food.
They have hot springs, and the rooms feel vaguely Japanese too."
Touya: "Though the village itself looks like somewhere in rural America.
Still, it's nice to have a change like this once in a while."
Yamato: "It really is.
Oh, where has everyone gone?"
Touya: "Hm? Now that you mention it...
No one's come back for a while..."
Yamato: "The women seem to have gone to the baths..."
Captain Roa: "..."
Touya: "Oh, Captain. Do you know where everyone is?"
Captain Roa: "...Mm."
Touya: "..."
Captain Roa: "..."
Yamato: "H-hey, Touya. Shall we go for a little walk?"
Touya: "Y-yeah... We'll be going out for a bit, then."
Yamato: "Excuse us..."
Captain Roa: "..."
Captain Roa: "...Hmm."
Yamato: "The Captain seemed a little lonely."
Touya: "But it's hard without Ymir around.
All I ever hear him say is 'Mm.'"
Yamato: "I'm sure she goes by the movement of his cheeks
and mouth, rather than the words."
Touya: "But I've seen Ymir answer him
without even looking at his face."
Yamato: "...It's a mystery."
Touya: "...Hm?"
????: "A pleasant breeze...
Have you come to cool off too, young one?"
Touya: "Y-yeah... Old man, are you from around here?"
????: "No. More to the point,
you have quite fine eyes."
Touya: "Huh? Do I? Thanks."
????: "Eyes as clear as this sky..."
Touya: "The sky? Mine aren't that pretty."
????: "But Rayblade, too, is Ze=Ode.
Never, ever let your guard down..."
Touya: "?! H-hey, what do you...?"
Kasumi: "Aaaaah!!"
Touya: "Kasumi?!"
Ai: "No..."
Aurelie: "...arguments!!"
Yamato: "...That came from the baths...
There's only one explanation. Peeping."
Touya: "With that much noise, it can't be just one person.
Oh, so that's why no one was in the room..."
Yamato: "Wouldn't Clovis be the ringleader?"
Touya: "...Honestly, what the hell are they doing...? No,
never mind that! Hey, old man!
What you said before... Huh?"
Touya: "...He's gone...?
Who was that old man...?"
Melissa: "They're lively, aren't they?"
Xiujian: "Yes."
Melissa: "Here, have another cup."
Xiujian: "Yes."

review_batches.context: All 287 source rows examined. This slice covers Kururu/Thora's thanks, Clovis age joke, Village Elder's identity, Grad's family and the army's pressure. Later restricted hot-spring scene is held, not drafted.
review_batches.decisions: Old man preserves the age joke without implying blood kinship. Keep Village Elder label unrevealed until source names it, Grad Burgley/Lion of the West and the Three Strongest Knights distinct from York's Three Sword Knights. Village damage/no injuries and army coercion are reported by the Elder. Do not supply a total list of strongest knights.

row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o000c7.l00: Old man renders the middle-age address as an age joke rather than an actual uncle relationship. Same wording repeats at 4, 8, 10 and 12.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o002f9.l00: Source generic man label is retained until Thora calls him Village Elder. Do not identify the later hidden old man as this person.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o0037e.p01.l00: Minor village damage and no injuries are the Elder's report. Do not turn earlier threatened burning/execution into accomplished events.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o00474.l00: Steinies has a personal feud with Grad, according to the Elder. No cause for the feud is supplied here.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o004dd.l01: Major Grad Burgley is the explicit full name/rank and Thora is his wife. Preserve the family connection rather than treating Burgley as a new place.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o0055c.l00: Lion of the West follows the existing Grad profile epithet. No confusion with Garyud's lion-themed battle invocations.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o005e5.l03: Sword Radiance holders are expressly excluded before the three strongest group. Three Strongest Knights of the Continent is not the Three Sword Knights of York.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o006b8.l00: Fain flatters Kururu retroactively, claiming he noticed her eyes from the first meeting. Keep his opportunistic boast rather than narrator-confirmed intuition.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o0070e.l00: Master remains Fain's source address. Do not insert a personal name or claim every knight shares this opinion.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o007c3.l00: Grad had left the army and lived here until recently; army threats against family sought to recall him. Do not recast this as a voluntary happy reenlistment.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o007c3.l04: Steinies was the negotiator in that coercion; no separate envoy is invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o00902.l01: Reporting the incident to Growster is the Elder's proposed safeguard. He claims lack of proof previously prevented action; no invented law or guaranteed future immunity.

review_batches.context: Village Elder's assurances, invitation and publicity joke through 97; restricted scene 98-159 held as part of the contiguous 98-228 passage. All member rows read.
review_batches.decisions: Keep his belief that reporting to Growster will protect the village as his assurance, not proof of runtime safety or legal authority. Fain calls a civilian a model warrior and Yamato qualifies the claim. Held rows remain null, not translated blanks or a silent adaptation.

row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o00a00.l00: Yamato says he seems a civilian, contrasting Fain's model-warrior praise. This is her impression, not a newly researched military biography.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o00a25.l01: Prince Tix rescued safely is this route's reported result. Do not overwrite it with the alternate Cain-escaped outcome.
row_decisions.scenario.s_016.o00afe.l01: Publicity benefit is the Elder's candid motive alongside gratitude; do not remove the commercial joke.
